name: Ledger — hardware wallets homepage by ledger.com
description: A full-black landing page where pure black fields dominate and only small controlled accents (orange primary buttons, purple gradients behind product shots, colourful crypto logos) carry energy. The hero pairs a compact headline block with a large gradient product render, followed immediately by a slim trust-stat strip. Rhythm alternates between wide cinematic full-width banners (the 'Bitcoin 3D' router banner, the cashback banner), bordered 4-up product comparison cards with corner tick marks, a sparse crypto-logo strip, and text-led sections with generous whitespace. Type scale is steep: very large white section headlines over small gray body copy. The page closes with a testimonial carousel, a two-column FAQ accordion, a huge centered closing statement in purple gradient, and a dense multi-column footer.
